Multiple Indian Education Entrance and Recruitment Exams Announce Registration Dates

Several Indian education and recruitment bodies have opened or are about to open registration periods for various examinations. The Bihar STET 2026 for teacher recruitment has begun accepting applications, with fees varying by candidate category. The MP TET 2026 exam is scheduled for October 12, with applications starting August 21. The All India Bar Examination (AIBE) 22 and the CSIR Senior Research Fellowship are also opening registration, with deadlines approaching for the latter. Additionally, the Bihar Board has opened a final registration window for Class 10 and 12 exams until August 22, and the CSEET October 2026 registration deadline is nearing.
